$comment: Approved Copilot models by cost tier. The ONE place to update when GitHub adds or retires models; `npm run lint:ai` rejects any agent/prompt model not listed here and warns when lastVerified is older than 90 days. Since June 2026 Copilot bills usage-based (tokens × model rate), so tier choice is a direct cost lever.

usage.economy: Explaining code, writing tests for existing code, docs, mechanical edits.
usage.standard: Implementing a reviewed plan, reviewing diffs, most bug fixes.
usage.premium: Planning cross-area changes, hard debugging, security-sensitive design. Short, high-leverage turns only.
